rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things relating to the environment, such as environmental policy or environmental issues.

example.english: This policy has a big environmental impact.
example.traditional: 呢項政策對環境方面嘅影響好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 deoi3 waan4 ging2 fong1 min6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this when environmental means designed to protect the environment or cause little environmental harm.

example.english: This cleaning product is environmental and does little harm to the environment.
example.traditional: 呢款清潔劑好環保，對環境冇乜傷害。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 cing1 git3 zai6 hou2 waan4 bou2 deoi3 waan4 ging2 mou5 mat1 soeng1 hoi6
